mg: Create an animation repair source sheet for Pickle Panic. Reference images show the approved character and its existing shoes. Draw ONLY two separate connected LOWER LEGS WITH FEET, side by side, on a genuinely transparent background. Left panel: character's screen-left lower leg with toe pointing left. Right panel: screen-right lower leg with toe pointing right. EACH PANEL IS ONE UNBROKEN ANATOMICAL PIECE: a short olive-green muscular calf with a soft rounded upper knee end, a cream ribbed sock covering a visibly present ankle, and a large mustard-yellow work shoe with dark black sole and laces. The sock goes INTO a complete raised, curved shoe collar: draw both collar sides and heel counter wrapping around the ankle. No flat-cut shoes, no floating foot, no horizontal amputated edge, no separate sock pasted above a shoe. The ankle is narrow but clearly substantial and continuously connected into the instep/heel. Proportions within each piece: total height about 1.15 times shoe length; green calf top 28% of height, sock/ankle middle 27%, shoe lower45%. Shoe is about 2.8 times the calf width. Keep the original huge rounded shoes and comic character style. Rough hand-ink dark contour, opaque flat spot colors olive #6A9F35, shadow #31572C, cream #FFF0CF, mustard #E9B83E, near-black #20231D. Few inside pickle warts, naturally tapering calf, no stacked ball knee and no cut lines across any joint. Clean alpha silhouette, no background, no text, no scene, no torso, no extra limbs, no fuzzy or light fringes, generous transparent margins. The left and right pieces must not touch. The whole calf-sock-shoe will be a single skinned mesh so the complete ankle anatomy must be drawn, not hidden.
